name: 38635 · Holly Springs, MS
findings: ZIP 38635 (Holly Springs) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38635 (Holly Springs) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 38635 (Holly Springs) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
